src/main/seanime/supervisor.ts — resolves through it; stop() no longer deletes anything
src/main/__tests__/seanimeDataDir.test.ts (new) — 12 tests incl. source guards against mkdtemp/rmSync returning

environment.flags: SEANIME_SIDECAR=1; SEANIME_DATADIR unset; SEANIME_EXE unset (exe resolved through exePath.ts)
environment.driver: the app's own debug bridge (no Windows mouse/keyboard control)

Every runtime JSON (library.json, media.json, profiles.json, profile-rules.json, study-orchestrator-v2.json, anki-intervals.json, …) is byte-identical to the pre-run backup.
